changes.comment: Test-only. Pins the behavior change @fgv/ts-extras makes in the same PR: useAiAssist threads providerConfig.endpoint into the params handed to whichever branch runs, so a configuration carrying BOTH a custom endpoint and a proxyUrl now surfaces a legible failure where it previously let the prompt be sent to the provider's default upstream. No hook code changed; nothing covered that combination before, which is most of why the underlying defect survived.
